04

How it works

STEP 01

Send your sketch

A napkin sketch, marked-up PDF, or site photos with rough dimensions — plus where it's being permitted.

STEP 02

I draft the set

Flat fee, typically 3–5 business days. You get a fully dimensioned, permit-oriented set.

STEP 03

Delivered + revised

PDF + editable DWG, revisions included until the set is right.

Scope Drafting services only — not engineering. Where your jurisdiction requires it, structural elements are stamped by a licensed Professional Engineer, arranged on your end. I deliver a clean set ready for that review.
